text: In column H (Name (Proper)) write every Employee Name in proper case without extra spaces, using the PROPER and TRIM functions (for example "  rAMESH  kumar SHARMA " becomes "Ramesh Kumar Sharma").
In column I (Joining Year) find the year of joining from the Joining Date using the YEAR function.
In column J (DA) find DA = Basic Pay × DA Rate given in cell T2, rounded to 0 decimal places with ROUND. Use an absolute reference ($T$2) so the formula can be filled down.
In column L (Gross Salary) find Gross Salary = Basic Pay + DA + Allowance. (Allowance in column K is already filled in for you.)
In Q4 find the 3rd highest Gross Salary using LARGE, and in Q5 the 2nd lowest Gross Salary using SMALL.
In Q7 count the employees who joined in 2015 or later (use column I with COUNTIF), and in Q8 count the employees without a mobile number using COUNTBLANK.
Format the Gross Salary range L2:L201 as Accounting Number Format with the ₹ symbol and 2 decimal places.
Freeze the top row of the sheet so the headings stay visible while scrolling.
With Conditional Formatting highlight the Top 10 Gross Salaries in L2:L201 with Green Fill with Dark Green Text.
Make the heading row A1:L1 Bold, give it Yellow fill colour and apply Wrap Text.
Apply All Borders to the complete table A1:L201.
Apply AutoFit Column Width to the columns A to L, and Center alignment to the Department column C2:C201.
Give the sheet tab a Blue Tab Color, and rename the sheet Sheet1 to "Employees".
Center align the Emp ID column A2:A201, and Bold the Basic Pay column F2:F201.
Apply Comma Style (Number Format, 0 decimal places) to the DA column J2:J201, and Center alignment to J2:J201.
